en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall cylindrical Romanesque bell tower made of brick, attached to a cathedral complex. Surrounding it are older stone buildings with arched windows and tiled roofs, and a domed structure on the right. The word "Ravenna" appears at the top left, and below the image is the caption "Campanile del Duomo." At the bottom are the printer's details and a circular stamp-like mark with the letters "M.C.T."
